items.titleZh: 凯迪拉克查明博塔斯墨西哥撞车原因并回退悬挂规格
items.summaryZh: 凯迪拉克F1车队在查明博塔斯墨西哥站撞车原因后，决定回退一款悬挂部件的规格。博塔斯表示腿部肌肉挫伤已“完全恢复正常”，本周末可以正常参赛。
items.originalTitle: Bottas crash diagnosis and his bold stance on Cadillac F1 future
items.summaryEn: The Cadillac Formula 1 team is rolling back the specification of a suspension component after diagnosing the cause of Valtteri Bottas's crash in Mexico. Bottas says his leg muscle bruising already feels "completely normal" and he has no issue getting back in the car this weekend.
detailZh: 凯迪拉克F1车队在查明上周末瓦尔特利·博塔斯在墨西哥戏剧性撞车的原因后，正在回退一款悬挂部件的规格。
博塔斯在墨西哥站第一个弯道左前悬挂失效，赛车倒退着撞上缓冲区深处的护墙，因此退赛。
幸运的是，博塔斯避免了严重到造成重大持久损伤的撞击。他周四在巴西透露，事发后他立即感到疼痛——当时他在无线电里一反常态地大声喊叫，并留在车内与FIA医疗团队交流——是因为赛车撞上护墙时他的右腿撞到了方向盘。
这让博塔斯留下了一些肌肉挫伤，他说现在感觉“已经完全恢复正常”，而且本周末重新坐进赛车没有问题，因为凯迪拉克已经查明了原因。
这与塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯在加拿大因制动导管热风泄漏导致前悬挂故障的情况类似，博塔斯的问题源于制动器产生的热量“传到了叉臂”。
无论如何，与佩雷斯相比，他的驾驶风格在制动器上倾向于产生更高的温度，但主要问题似乎是墨西哥赛道的挑战超出了凯迪拉克设定的容差范围，并且“在红色区域运行时间过长”。
在英特拉格斯赛道，由于这条赛道对制动和冷却的需求较低，这种情况不应重演，但凯迪拉克还是采取了必要的纠正措施作为预防，之后博塔斯表示需要“为未来进行良好的重新设计”。
“我们在温度方面确实有过某些限制，但我们不得不重新审视这些限制，”博塔斯说。
“我们不得不把一些部件改回旧规格。而且我们还不得不调低这些部件可以运行的温度上限。”
当被 The Race 问及那次规格变更时，博塔斯澄清道：“只是叉臂安装座的问题，是的。而且我们已经降低了限制，这在这里应该不成问题。”
“我们原以为那是安全的，但我们从未通过让它在那个温度下运行那么长时间来测试过。”
他补充道：“根据这里的天气预报，我认为我们应该没问题。”
“但他们在工厂还在用悬挂右侧部件做更多测试，那个部件现在已经回到银石了。”
“所以他们在做一些应力测试，并试图获得更精确的温度限制。”
博塔斯今年有一些令人沮丧的比赛表现，直接原因是不得不进行大量温度管理。
这对凯迪拉克来说一直是个以不同方式反复出现的问题，博塔斯似乎受影响更大，这无助于他对阵佩雷兹，后者被广泛认为是表现明显更好的凯迪拉克车手。
博塔斯几周前在美国大奖赛上表示，考虑到凯迪拉克作为新加入者的身份以及本赛季糟糕的可靠性记录，他认为评判这两位车手是“不可能的”——考虑到目前有关于他在车队未来的猜测，这一点尤为重要。
凯迪拉克正在努力确保科尔顿·赫塔获得F1超级驾照资格，尽管博塔斯签有多年合同，其他车手也一直在游说争取车队的比赛席位。
因此，博塔斯反复面临关于自己未来的问题，这种情况在英特拉格斯再次出现——他在那里表示“至少每个人都能看到我们面对的情况——许多问题和许多退赛”。
“而且不知为何，我的车在墨西哥温度更高，”博塔斯说。
“所以这意味着我必须做更多的管理，更多的抬油门滑行。而且即使我做了，我们仍然出现了故障。
“所以就今年表现的评价而言，并不是那么直接明了。”
博塔斯表示“懂的人自然懂”，并重申他从凯迪拉克及其多数股东TWG那里得到的信息是，他做得很好。
他预计自己的未来将在包括共同所有者通用汽车在内的董事会会议上得到正式确认，并且对他未来以及其他人候选资格的“大量噪音”感到“相当惊讶”。
“我所听到的一切都是，车队对我正在做的事情感到满意，”他说。
“但与此同时，我们知道这个世界是如何运作的。尤其是现在，每个人都想进入一级方程式。
“如果有人在某处看到了机会，他们就会想方设法去争取，无论以何种方式。
“但按照我们车队的架构方式，以及为未来做决策的方式，一切都需要得到董事会的批准。
“我相信那次会面还没有发生。但我一直确信没有任何变化。所以这就是我们目前的状况。”
尽管博塔斯觉得自己本赛季承担了车队大部分的问题，佩雷斯也经常直言凯迪拉克需要改进的地方还有很多。
不过，佩雷斯最近已将他的凯迪拉克合同延长至2029年，他在队内的位置似乎一直稳固得多。他出色的表现有时也让他有底气非常直率地谈论车队的发展曲线。
与此同时，博塔斯正在等待确认最初让他保留比赛席位的计划会得到履行，更不用说同意一份新合同了。
他说，凯迪拉克所处的局面，包括种种困难以及“他们并没有真正给我一辆能让我大有作为的赛车”这一事实，“一直是我第一年所预料的”——并称墨西哥站是一个“很好的例子”，说明凯迪拉克“目前要解决的问题比车手问题更大”。
博塔斯补充说，他对今年的预期“绝对不是一种为保住席位而战的心态”，当《The Race》提出，把他请来是为了经验和长期进步、随后却判定其表现不符合凯迪拉克的期望会略显奇怪时，他回答说：“我同意。那会非常奇怪。
“所以这就是为什么我不认为我的处境会有任何改变。
“这差不多一直就是约定。整个赛季我一直在真正遵循指令。有时候非常清楚，我只是努力把赛车带到终点线。
“但当然，总有一些人从外部观察，他们或许并不了解全局。然后你就会受到批评，这在赛车运动中很正常。”
“最重要的是我们知道自己的位置。我知道我的工作是什么。如果他们对我有进一步的要求，我相信他们会告诉我。”
detailEn: The Cadillac Formula 1 team is rolling back the specification of a suspension component after diagnosing the cause of Valtteri Bottas’s dramatic crash in Mexico last weekend.
Bottas shunted out of the Mexico race when his front left suspension failed at the first corner, sending the car backwards into the barrier deep into the run-off.

Fortunately, Bottas avoided a heavy enough hit to do significant lasting damage, as he revealed on Thursday in Brazil that his pain immediately afterwards - when he was uncharacteristically loud on the radio, and stayed in the car speaking to the FIA medical team - was because he banged his right leg against the steering wheel when the car made contact with the wall.

That left Bottas with some muscle bruising that he says feels “completely normal already”, and he has no issue getting back into the car again this weekend because Cadillac has already identified the cause.

Similar to when Sergio Perez suffered a front suspension failure in Canada due to a leak of hot air from brake ducts, Bottas’s problem arose from running heat from the brakes “going to the wishbones”.

He tends to run a bit hotter on the brakes with his driving style compared to Perez anyway, but the primary issue seems to be the Mexico challenge exceeding what Cadillac had set its tolerances to and “running too long a time in the red zone”.

This should not be repeated at Interlagos with less of a braking and cooling demand at this track, but Cadillac has taken the necessary corrective action as a precaution anyway before what Bottas said needs to be “good redesigning for the future”.
“We did have certain limits when it comes to temperatures, but we’ve had to review those,” Bottas said.
“We’ve had to revert some parts to older spec. And also we’ve had to revert the limits on temperatures that we can run on those.”
Asked by The Race about that spec change, Bottas clarified: “It’s just the wishbone mountings, yeah. And we’ve lowered the limits, which shouldn’t be an issue here.
“We thought it was safe, but we never tested by running it so long at that temperature.”
He added: “Based on the forecast here, I think we should be OK.
“But they’re still doing more testing at the factory with the right side of the suspension, that is now back in Silverstone.
“So they’re doing some stress testing and trying to get more accurate temperature limits on those.”
Bottas has had some demoralising race performances this year caused directly by having to engage in a lot of temperature management.

It has been a recurring issue for Cadillac in different ways, with Bottas seemingly more affected, which has not aided his cause against Perez, who is widely regarded as being the better performing Cadillac driver by some margin.

Bottas said at the United States Grand Prix a couple of weeks ago that he felt it was “impossible” to judge the two drivers given Cadillac’s newcomer status and poor reliability record this season – particularly significant right now given there is speculation over his future at the team.
Cadillac is pushing to make sure Colton Herta is eligible for an F1 superlicence and other drivers have been lobbying for a race seat with the team, despite Bottas being on a multi-year contract.
Bottas has therefore faced repeat questions about his future and this reoccurred at Interlagos - where he said “at least everyone can see what we’re dealing with – many issues and many DNFs”.
“And also for some reason my car was running hotter in Mexico,” Bottas said.
“So it meant I had to do more management, more lift and coast. And even though I did, still we had a failure.
“So it’s not so straightforward in terms of judging the performance this year.”
Bottas said “the people who know, they know” and reiterated that the message he has had from Cadillac and its majority owner TWG is that he is doing a good job.
He expects his future to be rubber-stamped by a board meeting involving co-owner General Motors and has been “quite surprised by the amount of noise” around his future and the candidacy of others.
“All I’ve heard, the team has been happy with what I’m doing,” he said.
“But at the same time, we know how this world works. And especially now, everyone wants to be in Formula 1.
“If somebody sees an opportunity somewhere, they’re going to try and go for it, one way or the other.
“But the way our team is structured, and the way decisions are made for the future, everything needs to be approved by the board.
“I believe that meeting is still yet to happen. But I’ve been convinced that nothing has changed. So that’s where we are.”
Though Bottas feels he has had the lion’s share of the team’s problems this season, Perez has often been outspoken about just how much Cadillac needs to improve.

Perez, though, extended his Cadillac deal through to 2029 recently and has always seemed to have much more security in his position. The quality of his performances has also emboldened him to speak very bluntly about the team’s progress curve at times, too.
Bottas, meanwhile, is waiting for confirmation that the original plan to keep him in a race seat is honoured, much less agree to a new deal.

He said the situation Cadillac’s in, including the difficulties and the fact “they haven’t really delivered me the car that I can do much” with, is “always what I expected for the first year” – and called Mexico a “good example” that Cadillac has “bigger problems to solve than the drivers at the moment”.

Bottas added that his expectation for this year was “definitely not a mindset to fight for my seat” and when suggested by The Race that it would be slightly odd to bring him in for experience and long-term progress, then make a judgement that the performance is not what Cadillac was looking for, he replied: “I agree. It would be very odd.
“So that’s why I don’t think anything is going to change in my situation.
“That was kind of always the deal. All season I’ve been really following instructions. Sometimes it has been very clear that I just try and get the car to the finish line.
“But of course there’s always people who look from the outside, they maybe don’t understand the big picture. Then you get the criticism, which is normal in this sport.
“The main thing is we know where we are. I know what my job is. If they want something further from me, then I’m sure they will tell me.”
keyPointsZh: 博塔斯在墨西哥站第一个弯道左前悬挂失效，赛车倒退撞上护墙。
他赛后疼痛是因为赛车撞墙时右腿撞到方向盘，留下肌肉挫伤。
与佩雷兹在加拿大因刹车导管热气泄漏导致前悬挂失效类似，博塔斯的问题源于刹车热量传到叉臂（wishbones）。
keyPointsEn: Bottas's front left suspension failed at the first corner in Mexico, sending the car backwards into the barrier.
His post-crash pain came from banging his right leg against the steering wheel when the car hit the wall, leaving muscle bruising.
Similar to Sergio Perez's front suspension failure in Canada caused by hot air leaking from brake ducts, Bottas's problem arose from brake heat "going to the wishbones".

items.titleZh: 多梅尼卡利：苹果或把F1转播权扩展至美国以外
items.summaryZh: F1首席执行官多梅尼卡利表示，苹果将在其他市场有机会时争取F1转播合同，把与Apple TV的美国独家转播合作扩展至美国以外。
items.originalTitle: F1 thinks Apple will expand broadcast rights beyond the US
items.summaryEn: F1 CEO Stefano Domenicali said Apple will look to broadcast F1 in other countries when opportunities arise, potentially expanding its exclusive US broadcast partnership with Apple TV beyond the United States.
detailZh: 据F1首席执行官斯特凡诺·多梅尼卡利（Stefano Domenicali）称，Apple TV作为F1美国独家转播合作伙伴的协议仍处于初期阶段，但这家科技巨头将寻求在其他国家转播F1。
今年，Apple TV与F1开始为期五年的合作，每场F1比赛都通过Apple TV平台向美国客户独家转播。
多梅尼卡利表示，Apple TV协议为F1触达美国18-24岁市场提供了“绝佳机会”，随后他回应了苹果本身是否会扩展、争夺其他国家F1转播合同的问题。
“答案是肯定的，”他说，“因为他们真正理解，至少我们讨论的一部分是，如果其他市场有机会，他们就会去做。”
“因为他们看到了，我们也能看到，这种影响在未来可能会更大，即便正如我们一直所说，我们的战略并不是在全球范围内只拥有一个主要媒体合作伙伴。我们需要确保在每个市场都最大化我们能拥有的机会。”
“但再一次强调，是的，一旦这个机会对他们开放，他们就会去做。”
苹果的全球雄心将对自由媒体集团‘有帮助’
多梅尼卡利对苹果及其产品的赞扬，是在F1母公司总裁德里克·张于奥斯汀举行的‘一级方程式高端策略’活动上发表讲话之后做出的，该活动由The Race和Axios主办。
张在活动上对 Axios 记者 Sara Fischer 表示：“我们原本就预期会有一个出色的合作伙伴。他们（苹果）的表现完全符合我们的预期，坦率地说甚至更好。”
“这是众所周知的事。这是一份为期五年的协议，我们完全打算在这段时间内与他们建立良好的合作关系，并希望合作能延续到之后。”
在第三季度电话会议上，张补充说，苹果有意竞标其他国家的 F1 转播合同，这对自由媒体集团“有帮助”，因为这会让这些合同进入竞标程序。
“更准确地说，苹果品牌与 F1 的关联，两者结合在一起非常互补。”
“那么另一部分可能是在产品层面……这个产品整体上可能已经超出了预期。”
“最后，你知道，苹果作为其他市场的潜在竞标者是有帮助的，即使我们不一定在这些市场选择他们，仅仅收紧市场从需求角度来说就是有帮助的。”
2026年5月，F1宣布与天空体育在英国和爱尔兰续签五年合同，同时天空体育意大利的合同延长至2032年。BeIN Sports获得其亚洲合同的续约，有效期至2030年底，其中东、北非和土耳其合同持续至2033年。
其他主要转播商包括DAZN，其在西班牙、安道尔和葡萄牙的转播合同持续至2030年，以及Viaplay，其荷兰和北欧合同持续至2029年底。
多梅尼卡利补充道：“全球电视观众在第三季度继续增长，包括意大利和荷兰赛事在内的多场赛事录得两位数的百分比增长。”
detailEn: Apple TV’s deal as Formula 1’s exclusive US broadcast partner is still in its infancy, but the tech giant will look to broadcast F1 in other countries, according to F1 CEO Stefano Domenicali.
This year, Apple TV and F1 began a five-year partnership in which every F1 race is broadcast exclusively on the Apple TV platform to US customers.

Domenicali said the Apple TV deal gave F1 an “incredible opportunity” to tap into the 18-24 market in the US, before addressing whether Apple itself could expand to vie for F1 broadcast contracts in other countries.
“The answer is yes,” he said. “Because they are really understanding that potentially, at least part of our discussion, if there are opportunities [to be] in other markets, they will do it.

“And because they see and we can see this effect could be bigger in the future, even if, as we always said, our strategy is not to have one main media partner all around the world. We need to make sure that we maximise the opportunity that we can have market by market.
“But once again, yes, they're going to do it as soon as this opportunity will be open for them.”
Apple’s global aspirations would be ‘helpful’ for Liberty
Domenicali’s praise for Apple and its offering comes after F1 parent company president Derek Chang spoke at 'Formula One's Premium Playbook', an event hosted by The Race and Axios in Austin.
Chang said to Axios Correspondent Sara Fischer at the event: "We anticipated having a great partner. They [Apple] performed exactly the way we thought and frankly even better.
"It's common knowledge. It's a five-year deal and we have every intent of having a great partnership with them during that time and hopefully beyond."
During the Q3 conference call, Chang added that Apple’s interest in bidding for F1 broadcast contracts in other countries is “helpful” to Liberty Media as it puts those contracts up for bidding.
“To put a finer point on it, the affiliation with the Apple brand and F1, the two together are very complementary.
“Then the other part is probably on the product side… this product as a whole has probably exceeded expectations.

“And then finally, you know, Apple as a potential bidder in other markets is helpful, even if we don't necessarily go with them in those markets, just tightening the markets is helpful from a demand standpoint.”

In May 2026, F1 announced a five-year contract extension with Sky in the UK and Ireland while Sky Italia’s contract was extended to 2032. BeIN Sports secured an extension to its Asian contract to run until the end of 2030, while its Middle East, North Africa and Turkey contracts last through 2033.
Other major broadcasters include DAZN, whose contract to broadcast in Spain, Andorra and Portugal runs through 2030, and Viaplay, whose Netherlands and Nordic contract lasts until the end of 2029.
Domenicali added that “growth in global TV audiences continues in the third quarter, with several events, including the Italian and Dutch events, recording double-digit percentage growth".
keyPointsZh: Apple TV与F1今年开始为期五年的合作，美国客户通过Apple TV平台独家观看每场F1比赛。
多梅尼卡利称Apple TV协议为F1触达美国18-24岁人群提供了“绝佳机会”。
多梅尼卡利强调F1的策略不是在全球只设一个主要媒体合作伙伴，而是要逐市场最大化机会。
keyPointsEn: Apple TV and F1 began a five-year partnership this year in which every F1 race is broadcast exclusively on the Apple TV platform to US customers.
Domenicali said the Apple TV deal gave F1 an "incredible opportunity" to tap into the 18-24 market in the US.
Domenicali stressed that F1's strategy is not to have one main media partner around the world, but to maximise opportunities market by market.

items.titleZh: 哈斯新秀卡马拉谈巴西主场提前首秀
items.summaryZh: 法拉利青训车手拉法·卡马拉原定2027年加盟哈斯，但因奥康在墨西哥站期间与车队提前解约，他将在巴西站提前完成F1首秀。卡马拉表示，这场出乎意料的主场首秀让他感到非常意外，但他打算好好享受，不让自己被巴西主场的压力压垮。

items.summaryEn: Ferrari junior Rafa Camara, originally set to join Haas in 2027, will make his F1 debut earlier than planned at the Brazilian Grand Prix after Esteban Ocon's split with the team midway through the Mexico weekend. Camara said the "very surprising" home debut caught him off guard, but he intends to soak it in without succumbing to the pressure of racing on home soil.
detailZh: 天赋新秀拉法·卡马拉谈在巴西“非常意外”的F1主场首秀
比原计划提前数月，2027年才将代表哈斯出战F1的拉法·卡马拉打算好好享受这场“非常意外”的主场首秀，同时不让自己被巴西主场的压力压垮。
如果拉法·卡马拉对提前完成F1首秀、而且还是在主场作战感到紧张，那他并没有表现出来。
这位法拉利青训车手已被征召，将于明年在哈斯顶替埃斯特班·奥康；而随着奥康在墨西哥站周末中途与车队高调解约，卡马拉本周末就将开启这段旅程。
对卡马拉不利的是，这位21岁的巴西车手此前从未驾驶过带有各种特性的2026款F1赛车，也从未在英特拉格斯赛道比赛过，而且他在本周末几乎没有准备机会。卡马拉原本被安排为法拉利参加第一节练习，因此他至少已经在马拉内罗完成了一些模拟器工作。
对这位现任F2锦标赛领跑者有利的是他巨大的潜力。在波尔蒂芒与哈斯进行的一次私人测试中，卡马拉速度极快，以至于正式车手奥利弗·贝尔曼都难以匹配他的圈速，这让哈斯车队老板小松礼雄大为震撼，足以将下赛季的席位交给他。卡马拉一直被视为法拉利的未来之星，或许是车手培养计划中涌现出的最出色的原始天赋，但仍需进一步打磨。
这层打磨是否已有机会定型，还有待观察。但在众多国际和地方媒体面前，无论是在文字采访环节还是在国际汽联新闻发布会上，略显害羞且沉稳的卡马拉看起来丝毫没有因这一场合而怯场。
当Motorsport.com问及接到电话在本周末驾驶VF-26赛车时，卡马拉说：“我非常惊讶。这绝对不是我预期中完成F1首秀的地方，但我为这个机会感到非常高兴，也非常感激车队本周对我的信任。所以我只是努力享受主场比赛，在赛道上玩得开心。”
主场首秀，尤其是在准备时间极少的临时通知下，从来都是一场火的洗礼。就在不久前，刚刚加冕世界冠军的基米·安东内利在2024年意大利大奖赛周五练习中撞车，上赛季在伊莫拉主场回归时又被周围的关注弄得筋疲力尽。
“会有很多事情发生，”卡马拉承认自从他的车手席位公布以来媒体和关注度激增。“但我觉得应该没问题。不管人们在谈论什么，或者外面发生什么，从来都不是真正的问题。我总是尽量只专注于自己这一边，专注于我能控制的事情，而外面发生什么并不真正在我的控制之下。所以我真的只是努力去那里做我知道该做的事。”
有帮助的是，由于2027年的车手席位已经到手，卡马拉知道自己可以专注于启动明年的准备工作，而不是感到必须出去证明自己，或者被诱惑去做太多事情。
“我真的只是在尽力尽可能多地学习，”这位卫冕FIA F3冠军说。“会有很多事情发生，但我觉得在我这边，我只是尽量把它看作一个积极的方面。在主场比赛是我很久没有做过的事情。所以我真的只是努力享受这个周末，找点乐趣。显然这不会容易，但我觉得对我一直有帮助的就是真正专注于自己这一边，专注于我的工作，并确保每一次你都在学习和前进。”
除了为2027年积累经验外，卡马拉也在努力确保自己不会忘记停下来沉浸于这一时刻。
“一旦我加入F3，在那里你会得到更多曝光，巴西车迷的支持真的非常大。看到他们如此热情地欢呼和支持你，总是让人感觉很棒，”他说。
“能够在所有人面前在这里完成我的第一场F1比赛，将会是非常特别的事情。当然，我会努力给他们带来一个美好的周末。”
detailEn: How raw talent Rafa Camara feels ahead of 'very surprising' F1 home debut in Brazil
Several months ahead of schedule, 2027 Haas Formula 1 debutant Rafa Camara intends to soak in a "very surprising" home debut without succumbing to the Brazilian pressure
If Rafa Camara felt any nerves about making his F1 debut earlier than expected, on home soil no less, then he didn't show it.

The Ferrari junior has been drafted in to replace Esteban Ocon at Haas next year, and already starts that journey this weekend after Ocon's high-profile split with the team halfway through the Mexico weekend.

Counting against Camara this weekend, the 21-year-old Brazilian has never driven a 2026 F1 car before with all its quirks, has never raced at Interlagos before and is coming into the weekend with few opportunities to prepare. Camara was actually slated to conduct FP1 for Ferrari, so he had at least completed some simulator work in Maranello.

What's counting for the current F2 championship leader is his immense potential. During a private test with Haas in Portimao, Camara was so quick that regular driver Oliver Bearman struggled to match his times and that blew Haas team boss Ayao Komatsu away enough to hand him the keys for next season. Camara has always been seen as a future star by Ferrari, perhaps the biggest raw talent coming through the driver program but one needing a layer of polish.

Whether or not that varnish has had a chance to set remains to be seen. But in front of throngs of international and local media, both in his print huddle and in the FIA's press conference, the somewhat shy and even-keeled Camara looked anything but overawed by the occasion.

"I was very surprised," Camara said when asked by Motorsport.com about receiving the phone call to jump into the VF-26 this weekend. "Definitely not a place where I would expect to make my debut in Formula 1, but just very happy for the opportunity, very grateful as well for the team to put trust in me this week. So I'm just trying to enjoy the home race and have some fun out there."

A home debut, especially on short notice with little preparation time, is always a baptism of fire. It wasn't all that long ago when recently crowned world champions Kimi Antonelli crashed in Friday practice at the 2024 Italian Grand Prix, and was left drained by the attention around his Imola homecoming last season.

"There will be a lot of things going on," Camara acknowledged the surge in media and attention since his drive was announced. "But I think it should be all right. Whatever people are speaking [about] or what's happening outside, it's never been a real problem. I always try to just focus on my side, focus on things that I can control, and whatever is happening outside is not really under my control. So I just really try to go there and do what I know what to do."

What helps is that with a 2027 drive already in the bag, Camara knows he can focus on kickstarting his preparation for next year, rather than feeling the urge to go out and prove himself, or be tempted to do too much.

"I'm just really trying to learn as much as I can," the reigning FIA F3 champion said. "There will be a lot of things going on, but I think on my side I just try to see it as a positive note. Just driving at home is something that I didn't do for a long time. So I'm just really trying to enjoy this weekend and just have some fun. Obviously it will be not easy, but I think what always helps for me is just really focus on my side, focus on my job, and make sure that every time you're learning and moving forwards."
As well as filling his experience back for 2027, Camara is trying to make sure he doesn't forget to stop and soak it in the occasion, too.
"Once I joined F3, where you get more exposed, the support from the Brazilian fans was really big. And it's always been nice to see how much they cheer and how much they support you," he said.
"Just being able to do my first F1 race here in front of everyone, would be something very special. For sure, I'll try to give them a nice weekend."

items.originalTitle: Ferrari confirms Charles Leclerc's Brazilian GP schedule after birth of first child
detailZh: 法拉利确认查尔斯·勒克莱尔巴西大奖赛日程，在首个孩子出生后
法拉利确认，查尔斯·勒克莱尔将因女儿出生而缺席周四的巴西大奖赛媒体活动
对于法拉利车迷来说。这是最新的Scuderia 法拉利 F1新闻，车手更新，技术分析和来自马拉内洛及更远处的比赛反应
法拉利确认，查尔斯·勒克莱尔将因首个孩子的出生而缺席周四的巴西大奖赛前媒体日
摩纳哥车手和他的妻子亚历山德拉本周宣布，他们迎来了他们的女儿比安卡，法拉利已经解释了这对他在圣保罗的赛车周末意味着什么。
车手们在周四的媒体活动通常是强制性的，但这样的缺席将被视为批准的豁免，而不是违反规定。
车队在社交媒体上发布称，查尔斯因女儿出生而免除今天在圣保罗的媒体活动。
马拉内洛车队补充说，勒克莱尔将及时到达赛道，参加剩余的赛车周末。法拉利补充说：“他将于明天早上恢复正常的赛道活动。”
勒克莱尔将在第一场练习赛中由迪诺·贝加诺维奇取代，这是强制性新秀出场的部分，因此勒克莱尔本周末的首个赛道练习将是FP2。
这将是在2026年一级方程式赛季中贝加诺维奇的第三个FP1练习。车队最初计划让拉斐尔·卡马拉参加练习。但当哈斯车队宣布他将取代埃斯特班·奥康完成本赛季剩余的比赛时，他的练习首秀计划发生了变化。
2026赛季还剩下四轮比赛。当梅赛德斯车队的基米·安东内利在墨西哥大奖赛中赢得了他的首个冠军头衔时，排名第二的争夺战仍在继续。勒克莱尔目前在锦标赛中排名第五，但29岁的他和红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在第二名的差距只有16分。
巴西大奖赛将于11月8日在英特拉戈斯举行，当地时间下午2点（英国时间下午5点）。
detailEn: Ferrari confirms Charles Leclerc's Brazilian GP schedule after birth of first child
Ferrari has confirmed Charles Leclerc will miss Thursday's media commitments at the Brazilian Grand Prix following the birth of his daughter
For Ferrari fans. The latest Scuderia Ferrari F1 news, driver updates, technical analysis and race reaction from Maranello and beyond.
Ferrari has confirmed that Charles Leclerc will miss Thursday's media day ahead of the Brazilian Grand Prix following the birth of his first child.

The Monegasque driver and his wife, Alexandra, announced earlier this week that they had welcomed their daughter, Bianca, and Ferrari has now explained what this means for his race weekend in São Paulo.
Drivers' Thursday media commitments are normally mandatory, but an absence like this would be treated as an approved exemption rather than a breach of the regulations.
"Charles has been exempt of attending media activities today in São Paulo, following the birth of his daughter," the team posted on social media.

The Maranello outfit added that Leclerc will arrive at the track in time to take part in the remainder of the race weekend. "He will resume regular track activities from tomorrow morning," Ferrari added.
Leclerc is already due to be replaced by Dino Beganovic in the first practice session as part of the mandatory rookie outings, so Leclerc's first on-track session this weekend will be FP2.

This will be Beganovic's third FP1 session of the 2026 Formula 1 season. The team had initially planned to run Rafael Camara for the practice session. But plans for his practice debut changed when Haas announced he would replace Esteban Ocon for the remainder of the season.

There are just four rounds remaining in the 2026 season. While Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli claimed his maiden championship title at the Mexican Grand Prix, the fight for second in the standings continues. Leclerc currently sits fifth in the championship, but only 16 points separate the 29-year-old and Red Bull's Max Verstappen in second.
The Brazilian Grand Prix will take place at Interlagos on Sunday 8 November at 2pm local time (5pm UK time).
